release_notes:
🚀 UPDATE V1.2.14+40: PERFORMANCE & BUG FIXES
• Multi-Stock Pricing: Home screen now displays specific live prices for each stock in an alert.
• Pricing Fallbacks: Added Finnhub and User-Agent rotation for 100% price fetch reliability during high load.
• Improved Date Ranges: Indirect Sector/Macro impact alerts now accurately show their estimated date ranges (e.g., T+0 to T+3).
• Indian Indices: Fixed NIFTY and BANKNIFTY live pricing by mapping exact Angel tokens.
